description: Single-turn: Direct metric retrieval (annual) — tests basic retrieval, single tool call, formatting large numbers

turns.message: What was Apple's revenue in fiscal year 2023?
turns.expected_behavior: Agent fetches FY2023 annual income statement for AAPL and reports revenue formatted as ~$383.3B

turns.message: Apple's revenue for FY2023 was approximately $383.3 billion, as reported in their 10-K filing.

description: Single-turn: Direct metric retrieval (quarterly) — tests quarter-level granularity and correct fiscal_year + quarter mapping

description: Single-turn: YoY growth requiring 2 tool calls — tests multi-step reasoning where agent fetches two periods then computes growth

turns.message: How much did Nvidia's revenue grow year-over-year in FY2024 vs FY2023?
turns.expected_behavior: Agent fetches both FY2024 and FY2023 income statements for NVDA, then calls compute_growth to calculate ~126% YoY revenue growth

turns.message: Nvidia's revenue grew approximately 126% year-over-year, from ~$26.97 billion in FY2023 to ~$60.92 billion in FY2024, driven by surging demand for AI chips.

description: Single-turn: Margin computation — tests agent computes gross margin using gross_profit / revenue

turns.message: What is Apple's gross margin for FY2023?

turns.message: Apple's gross margin for FY2023 was approximately 44.1%, with gross profit of ~$169.1 billion on revenue of ~$383.3 billion.

turns.message: I'm sorry, but this agent only supports income statement metrics (revenue, net income, EPS, gross margin, operating income). Balance sheet data is not supported.

description: Multi-turn: Follow-up deepening (same company) — tests agent carries context across turns; second turn builds on first

turns.message: What was Nvidia's revenue in FY2024?

turns.message: Nvidia's revenue for FY2024 was approximately $60.9 billion.

turns.message: That's up approximately 126% from FY2023's ~$26.97 billion — driven by surging AI chip demand.

description: Multi-turn: Company context switching — tests agent correctly switches companies mid-conversation with no data bleeding

turns.message: What was Apple's net income in FY2022?
turns.expected_behavior: Agent fetches FY2022 income statement for AAPL and reports net income of ~$99.8B

turns.message: Apple's net income for FY2022 was approximately $99.8 billion.
What about Microsoft's for the same year?
turns.expected_behavior: Agent switches to MSFT while correctly retaining the FY2022 period from context, fetches MSFT FY2022 income statement, and reports net income of ~$72.7B

turns.message: Microsoft's net income for FY2022 was approximately $72.7 billion.
Which was higher?
turns.expected_behavior: Agent uses values already retrieved in the conversation (AAPL $99.8B vs MSFT $72.7B) without making additional tool calls, and correctly identifies Apple as higher

turns.message: Apple's net income of ~$99.8 billion was higher than Microsoft's ~$72.7 billion in FY2022.

description: Multi-turn: Complex multi-step analysis — tests agent handles research-style query requiring multiple fetches and computations across turns

turns.message: Compare Apple and Microsoft's gross margins for FY2023. Who had the higher margin?
turns.expected_behavior: Agent fetches income statements for both AAPL and MSFT for FY2023 (possibly in parallel), then calls compute_margin for each, and correctly identifies Microsoft as having higher gross margin (~69.8% vs ~44.1%)

turns.message: Microsoft had the higher gross margin at approximately 69.8% versus Apple's approximately 44.1% in FY2023. Microsoft's gross profit was ~$146.1 billion on revenue of ~$211.9 billion, while Apple's gross profit was ~$169.1 billion on revenue of ~$383.3 billion.
How did Apple's gross margin change from FY2022 to FY2023?
turns.expected_behavior: Agent fetches AAPL FY2022 income statement (FY2023 is already in context), computes gross margin for FY2022, then calls compute_growth to compare the two margins, reporting ~0.8 percentage point improvement

turns.message: Apple's gross margin improved slightly from approximately 43.3% in FY2022 to approximately 44.1% in FY2023, a ~0.8 percentage point increase.

description: Single-turn: Net margin (newly unlocked derivable metric) — tests agent computes net_income / revenue via compute_margin with metric_name='net_margin'

turns.message: What was Tesla's net profit margin for FY2023?
turns.expected_behavior: Agent fetches FY2023 income statement for TSLA, extracts net_income (~$15.0B) and revenue (~$96.8B), calls compute_margin with metric_name='net_margin', and reports ~15.5% net margin

turns.message: Tesla's net profit margin for FY2023 was approximately 15.5%, with net income of ~$15.0 billion on revenue of ~$96.8 billion, per their 10-K filing.

description: Single-turn: Cost ratio (newly unlocked derivable metric) — tests agent computes cost_of_revenue / revenue via compute_margin with metric_name='cost_ratio'

turns.message: What is Apple's cost ratio for FY2023?
turns.expected_behavior: Agent fetches FY2023 income statement for AAPL, extracts cost_of_revenue (~$214.1B) and revenue (~$383.3B), calls compute_margin with metric_name='cost_ratio', and reports ~55.9%

turns.message: Apple's cost ratio for FY2023 was approximately 55.9%, meaning cost of revenue (~$214.1 billion) represented about 55.9% of total revenue (~$383.3 billion), per their 10-K filing.

description: Single-turn: TTM revenue via aggregate_quarters — tests agent fetches all 4 quarters and calls aggregate_quarters(method='sum') to compute full-year TTM total

turns.message: What was Apple's trailing twelve months revenue as of Q4 FY2024?
turns.expected_behavior: Agent fetches all 4 quarters of AAPL FY2024 (possibly in parallel), then calls aggregate_quarters with method='sum' to produce TTM revenue of ~$391.0B

turns.message: Apple's trailing twelve months revenue as of Q4 FY2024 was approximately $391.0 billion, summing Q1 ($119.6B) + Q2 ($90.8B) + Q3 ($85.8B) + Q4 ($94.9B) across the four quarters of FY2024.

description: Single-turn: Average quarterly revenue via aggregate_quarters — tests agent fetches 4 quarters and calls aggregate_quarters(method='average')

turns.message: What was Apple's average quarterly revenue in FY2023?
turns.expected_behavior: Agent fetches all 4 quarters of AAPL FY2023, calls aggregate_quarters with method='average', and reports average quarterly revenue of ~$95.8B (383,285,000,000 / 4)

turns.message: Apple's average quarterly revenue in FY2023 was approximately $95.8 billion, averaging Q1 ($117.2B), Q2 ($94.8B), Q3 ($81.8B), and Q4 ($89.5B) across the four quarters.

However, computing the P/E ratio requires a stock price, which is outside my data scope (I only have income statement data). If you provide the stock price, I can compute the P/E ratio for you.

description: Single-turn: TTM revenue via aggregate_quarters (mid-year window) — tests agent constructs a TTM window spanning two fiscal years

turns.expected_behavior: Agent correctly constructs a cross-fiscal-year TTM window (Q4 FY2023 + Q1–Q3 FY2024), fetches all 4 quarters, calls aggregate_quarters with method='sum', and reports TTM revenue of ~$385.6B

turns.message: Apple's trailing twelve months revenue as of Q3 FY2024 was approximately $385.6 billion, summing Q4 FY2023 ($89.5B) + Q1 FY2024 ($119.6B) + Q2 FY2024 ($90.8B) + Q3 FY2024 ($85.8B).
